newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle steady-up $1, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle steady-up $1, light - USDA.

text.p: - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were fully steady in a light test, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade and demand was moderate. Seller interest was light to moderate.
Wk to Date- 19,700 Week Ago - 19,400 Year Ago - 27,900
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lb few 65.00-65.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1200 lb few 65.00-65.50.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared with Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1300 lb 104.00-104.50 few 105.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 99.00-100 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 101.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 96.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lb 104.00-104.50 ld 105.00 ld 102.50.
